---
title: "Directional variograms and anisotropy"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

Angles follow gstat: clockwise from positive Y (north) and periodic over 180
degrees. Inspect pair counts and stability before interpreting directional
ranges. `ps_anisotropy()` reports an exploratory major-continuity direction and
minor-to-major range ratio only when supported. Weak or conflicting evidence
produces a warning, and the result is never activated automatically.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
a <- ps_anisotropy(points, directions=seq(0,135,45), minimum_pairs=20)
```
